board.update_hint_owner: Next step: keep this line exactly as kander show prints it; kander move <task-id> working --owner writes it.
board.update_hint_session: Next step: keep this line exactly as kander show prints it; kander start and kander resume write it.
board.update_hint_result: Next step: keep this line exactly as kander show prints it; kander move writes it on entering done, archived, or trash.
board.update_hint_created: Next step: keep this line exactly as kander show prints it; kander new writes it.
board.update_hint_dispatch_field: Next step: keep this line exactly as kander show prints it; the dispatch and notify flow writes it.
board.update_hint_internal: Next step: keep this line exactly as kander show prints it; Kander transactions write it.
board.update_hint_resolved: Next step: keep the *_RESOLVED lines exactly as kander show prints them; kander start and kander review write them.
board.update_hint_reviews_section: Next step: keep the REVIEWS section exactly as kander show prints it; kander review publishes it. Record review dispositions with kander review disposition.
board.update_hint_dispatches_section: Next step: keep the DISPATCHES section exactly as kander show prints it; the dispatch and notify flow writes it.
board.update_hint_dispositions_section: Next step: keep the REVIEW_DISPOSITIONS section exactly as kander show prints it; it is a historical section and no command writes it.
board.update_hint_contract_decisions_sec: Next step: keep the CONTRACT_DECISIONS section exactly as kander show prints it; update --contract-decision-file writes it.
board.update_hint_lifecycle_section: Next step: keep the LIFECYCLE_DECISION section exactly as kander show prints it; the termination options of kander move and the claim and handoff flow write it.
board.update_hint_managed_path: Next step: a dedicated command publishes this path; update cannot write it.
board.update_hint_duplicate: Next step: keep each field and section once; merge the new content into the existing one.
board.update_hint_frozen: Next step: the frozen contract is GOAL, USER_DECISIONS, EXPECTED_OUTCOME, ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA, OUT_OF_SCOPE, TASK_GROUP, SIZE, the pin fields, and the PREREQUISITES line. Write execution records into DISCUSSION or IMPLEMENTATION. In working or review, toggling top-level acceptance items between - [ ] and - [x] needs no decision. To change the contract, get the user's decision first, then pass --contract-decision-file.
board.dispatch_cycle_changed: Dispatch {{.V0}} belongs to an earlier execution cycle; the execution cycle has changed since it was prepared. Next step: prepare a new dispatch for the current execution.
board.dispatch_end_decision_required: Dispatch {{.V0}} was accepted, so its executor may still be running. Next step: stop the executor, then rerun with --decision <user-decision-reference>.
board.update_group_checkpointed: Group {{.V0}} has a coordinator checkpoint, so its member set is frozen and TASK_GROUP cannot change.
board.update_hint_group_checkpointed: Next step: keep the TASK_GROUP line as it is; move new work into a separate group or a standalone card.
launch.execution_has_no_session: {{.V0}} has no executor session: its current execution is a {{.V1}} record. Next step: the session that claimed the card continues it; to replace that session, use kander resume --agent <agent> (see snippets/failure-recovery.md).
